C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 197
Date 24/3/16

Municipal Police.
ORIGINAL INVESTIGATION DEPT.
Captain Superintendent's Office.

Shanghai, March 23rd 1916.

Sir,
General Yang went to Sungkiang by boat yesterday
leaving the Arsenal at 9 a.m. and returning at 3 p.m.
It is reported that the Arsenal Authorities have
received information that Honan will soon declare
independence.
General Tsang Tsung Sung 張振聲 whose arrival here
from Peking was reported on 18th instant, left for
Nanking yesterday.
General Yang has installed two police officers
as censors in the Chinese Post Office. Their names
are Kwoh Tsung Voh 郭增發 alias Kwoh Teh San 郭德三
and Wong Tong Bing 汪東平. They will censor all
letters arriving from Dalny and Japan. They started
work yesterday.
At the present time there are 2,200 men employed
in the Arsenal works. One thousand of these are
engaged in making ammunition while the others are
constructing big guns.
It is reported that Pay Zung Sung 貝潤生 the Chairman
of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, received a letter
from the rebels a few days ago, saying that they would
start soon in Shanghai and that they would hold him
responsible for all expenses connected with the rising.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmmmuuuchins

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

（批：K 23/3）

刑事侦缉处
情报登记处
第 197 号
日期 16/3/24

公共租界警务处。
原调查科。
警监办公室。

上海，1916 年 3 月 23 日。

先生：

杨将军昨日乘船前往松江，上午 9 时离开兵工厂，下午 3 时返回。
据报，兵工厂当局已收到消息，称河南即将宣布独立。
曾宗松（音译）将军（張振聲）于本月 18 日被报从北京抵达此处，昨日已启程前往南京。
杨将军已在华邮局安插两名警官担任检查员。其姓名分别为郭增發（别名郭德三）和汪東平。他们将检查所有从大连和日本寄来的信件。他们已于昨日开始工作。
目前兵工厂雇有工人 2,200 名。其中一千人从事弹药制造，其余人员则在制造大炮。
据报，华人总商会会长贝润生（Pay Zung Sung，音译）数日前收到叛军来信，称他们即将在上海起事，并将要求他对与此次起义相关的所有费用负责。

您顺从的仆人，

mmmmmuuuchins

首席探长。

警务处警监。

（批注：K 23/3）
